subject: Greenleaf: short-form customer insights video — scheduling & release
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@greenleaf.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenleaf: short-form customer insights video — scheduling & release

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to share a 3–4 minute on-camera piece about how Greenleaf uses Redwood Inference for clinical workflow extraction. We want to keep this short and unscripted — a few talking points and a relaxed shoot on your campus will be perfect.

High-level ask: would you and Samir be available for a 2-hour block the week of Sept 27? We’ll bring a 1‑cam setup, a lav mic per speaker, and a brief b‑roll pass of your clinic.

Attached: a rough shoot itinerary and the first draft of a release form (PDF stub). If legal prefers DocuSign, we can route it that way.

Proposed talking points (we can refine):
- Brief intro: role + what Greenleaf does
- The specific problem Redwood helped with (data ingest + latency improvements)
- A concrete outcome or metric (reduced triage time, fewer manual steps)
- One-sentence advice for teams considering inference platforms

Next steps: confirm availability, let us know any on-site restrictions (patient areas, privacy), and confirm who will sign the release.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0124
From: Elena Garcia <elena@greenleaf.health>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleaf.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Greenleaf: short-form customer insights video — scheduling & release

Alex —

Thanks for the note. We’re happy to do this. Sept 28th in the afternoon looks best: 1pm–3pm works for both me and Samir. I’ll need to run the release form by our legal / communications team; I’ve looped Samir so he can confirm.

Two quick constraints: we can’t film inside procedure rooms and we need to blur any patient data that might appear in on-screen EHRs. Also, our PR lead will want to approve the final cut.

I’ll review the attached release and get back to you by EOD Thursday with any edits.

—Elena
Director of Clinical Ops
Greenleaf Health

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenleaf: short-form customer insights video — scheduling & release

Elena / Alex —

Quick logistics note from production: we’ll need a single point of contact on-site for check-in, a quiet room for interviews (10x12ft ideal), and a table for our laptop + slate. The crew is two people: DP + producer. We’ll be respectful of patient flow and can tape off areas if needed.

Also attaching a 1-page run-of-show and a minimal shot list (PDF stub). For b-roll we’ll capture exterior signage, reception flow, and a short sequence of non‑identifiable chart interaction (no patient identifiers).

If Greenleaf has branded assets (logos, lower-thirds legal text), please drop in the Drive folder linked below.

If legal has edits to the release, happy to accept tracked changes or a mark-up and reissue a DocuSign link.

—Marissa
Senior Producer | Redwood Inference Marketing

Attachments: shoot_itinerary_20260928.pdf (stub), b-roll_shotlist.xlsx (stub)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleaf.health>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Elena Garcia <elena@greenleaf.health>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Greenleaf: short-form customer insights video — scheduling & release

Alex / Marissa —

Thanks. Sept 28 from 1pm–3pm is confirmed on our side. Our on-site contact will be Priya N. (clinical operations coordinator) — she’ll meet your team at reception and escort them. Priya’s cell: +1 (212) 555-0789.

Legal reviewed the release and requested two small edits:
1) Add a clause that Greenleaf can request a second review before public release.
2) Confirm that no PHI will be included and any EHR screenshots will be fully redacted.

I’ve attached the redlined release (we signed and returned a PDF stub here for tracking). If you can send a DocuSign by EOD tomorrow, I’ll sign the final version.

—Samir
VP, Engineering Operations | Greenleaf Health

Attachment: Greenleaf_Release_Form_v1.pdf (redline stub)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@greenleaf.health>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenleaf.health>

Date: Mon, 29 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenleaf: short-form customer insights video — scheduling & release

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Samir. We’ve updated the release to include the two clauses you requested and routed it via DocuSign (link below). Marissa: will you confirm the crew call time and parking instructions?

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/XYZ-GREENLEAF-release
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cGreenleafAssets

Tentative shoot call: 12:30pm on Sept 28 at Main Street entrance. Crew will aim to be out by 3pm. We’ll share a first cut for PR review within 5 business days.

Appreciate your partnership — looking forward to showcasing Greenleaf’s work.

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
